scope_areas.summary: Find businesses that appear in Google for searches that matter to you, then compare their pages and topics.
examples: Identify competing businesses in Google search
Compare questions and topics their pages cover
Get a report of gaps and possible opportunities

scope_areas.name: On-Page SEO — Improve Your Website Pages
scope_areas.summary: See what individual pages could explain better to people and Google. Actual changes are separately agreed.
examples: Review page titles, headings and descriptions
Suggest clearer text and useful links
Agree which improvements are worth making first

faq.question: Can you find keywords for my business before I have a website?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell us what you sell and which country or language you want to reach. Keyword research gives you a list of relevant Google searches. Keyword clustering means grouping related phrases together in a spreadsheet.

faq.question: What is the difference between keyword research and an SEO audit?
faq.answer: Keyword research shows what customers search for, while an SEO audit checks an existing website for issues that may affect search visibility. A website is not required for keyword research.

faq.question: What will I receive from a service?
faq.answer: Depending on the work you choose: a keyword spreadsheet grouped by topic, a website audit with a list of priorities, or a consultation with practical next steps. The result and scope are confirmed before work starts.

faq.question: Will you make changes to my website or send a report?
faq.answer: Keyword research, a website audit and consultation can be delivered as research, reports or advice. Website editing, new text and technical fixes require a separate agreement.

faq.question: Can you guarantee first place in Google?
faq.answer: No. We can research searches, identify issues and recommend improvements, but search engines decide rankings and traffic. We do not offer purchased links intended to manipulate rankings.
